_comment: SEARCH COMPLETENESS for cards the loop draws: a Curiosity loop that STOPS SHORT (the library runs dry) has drawn a castable card, and the search must cast it the same turn. Mid-turn frame (resume_at main1, land drop spent): a summoning-sick Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind wearing Curiosity (it can neither attack nor tap), Island + Mountain; hand Preordain; the whole library is five cards with one Lightning Bolt among them; opponent at 8. Preordain draws, that draw pings, Curiosity draws the rest of the library -- 5 pings (8 -> 3), Curiosity's 'may' declines on the empty library so we are never decked -- and the Bolt the loop drew is cast off the Mountain for the last 3. Without the post-ping re-solve the Bolt waits in hand, the turn ends at 3 and the next draw step decks us. Fails if the breakpoint stops seeing the loop's draws or the loop overdraws.
